sloka: न विनश्येत्कथं कार्यं वैक्लब्यम् न कथं भवेत् ।लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य कथं नु न वृथा भवेत् ॥५-२-४१॥
transliteration: na vinaśyetkathaṁ kāryaṁ vaiklabyam na kathaṁ bhavet ।laṅghanaṁ ca samudrasya kathaṁ nu na vṛthā bhavet ॥5-2-41॥

translations.english: 'How should the task be performed? How to avoid impetuousness? How can my purpose of crossing the ocean be not wasted?
